triples.head_surface: cooling spaces of each gas inlet and outlet casing
triples.head_canonical_zh: 燃气进排气壳体冷却腔
triples.tail_surface: hydrostatically tested to 1.5 times the working pressure but not to be less than 4 bar
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 1.5倍工作压力液压试验(不低于4巴)
triples.evidence_text: The cooling spaces of each gas inlet and outlet casing are to be hydrostatically tested to 1.5 times the working pressure but not to be less than 4 bar.

triples.head_surface: compressor and turbine, the shaft and bladed wheels, as well as the full rotating assembly
triples.head_canonical_zh: 压气机与涡轮、轴及叶轮、整个旋转组件
triples.tail_surface: dynamically balanced individually in accordance with the manufacturer’s quality control procedure
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 按制造商质控程序单独动平衡
triples.evidence_text: The compressor and turbine, the shaft and bladed wheels, as well as the full rotating assembly, are to be dynamically balanced individually in accordance with the manufacturer’s quality control procedure, accepted by ABS.

triples.tail_surface: shop trial, either on a test bed or on a test engine
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 台架或试验发动机工厂验收试验
triples.evidence_text: Upon completion of fabrication and assembly, each Category C turbochargers are to be subjected to a shop trial, either on a test bed or on a test engine, in accordance with the manufacturer's test schedule

triples.tail_surface: overspeed tested for 3 minutes on a test bed at 20% above the alarm level speed at ambient temperature, or 10% above alarm level speed at 45°C inlet temperature when tested in the actual housing with the corresponding pressure ratio
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 超速试验(3分钟/超报警转速20%常温或10%@45°C)
triples.evidence_text: Compressor wheels are to be overspeed tested for 3 minutes on a test bed at 20% above the alarm level speed at ambient temperature, or 10% above alarm level speed at 45°C inlet temperature when tested in the actual housing with the corresponding pressure ratio.

triples.tail_surface: operated in the presence of the Surveyor to demonstrate its ability to function satisfactorily under operating conditions and its freedom from harmful vibrations at speeds within the operating range
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 验船师见证运行验证(工况正常且无有害振动)
triples.evidence_text: Before final acceptance, each turbocharger, after installation on the engine, is to be operated in the presence of the Surveyor to demonstrate its ability to function satisfactorily under operating conditions and its freedom from harmful vibrations at speeds within the operating range.
